operation.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Returns a single package by its id, as a flat object (no wrapper).

### Deleted packages
A deleted package is still returned by this endpoint, with `deleted_at` set to the time it was deleted. The list endpoint hides such packages, so this is the only place a non-null `deleted_at` appears.

### Branches
No branch restriction applies here — a package belonging to any branch can be fetched by its id.

### Notes
- The trailing `1` in the path is an optional data-detail level. It has no effect for packages, which are always returned as flat records; a non-numeric value is treated as `1`.
- An unknown id does **not** return `404`. It returns `500` with the plain-text body `error happened`, so do not parse the failure body as JSON.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Id of the package to return.

period_value.description: How many `period_unit` intervals the package covers, e.g. `3` with `monthly` means three months.

period_unit.description:
The unit the validity period is counted in.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `daily` | Days |
| `weekly` | Weeks |
| `monthly` | Months |
| `yearly` | Years |
| `not-expired` | Never expires |

status.description:
Whether the package can be sold.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Inactive |
| 1 | Active |

product_id.description: Id of the product this package is linked to, or `null` when it is not linked to one.

deleted_at.description: When the package was deleted, `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`, or `null` while it is active.

type.description:
What the package sells.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `credit_charge` | A bundle of credits |
| `membership` | A membership subscription |

branch_id.description: Branch the package belongs to, or `null` when it is not assigned to one.

401.description: Authentication failed, or the caller may not view packages.

message.description: Returned when the access token is missing, expired or invalid.

error.description: Returned instead of `message` when the account is authenticated but not permitted to view packages.

500.description: The package could not be loaded — most commonly because no package has that id. The body is the plain text `error happened`, not JSON.

schema.description: Plain-text body. Returned when the id does not exist, or the package could not be loaded.
